hooks.command: jq empty .claude-plugin/marketplace.json 2>&1 && echo 'OK: marketplace.json valid' || echo 'ERROR: marketplace.json has invalid JSON — fix before committing'

test -z "$(git -C "${PWD}" ls-files --others --modified --exclude-standard docs/plans/ 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'WARNING: Uncommitted plan files in docs/plans/ — commit alongside related changes (see .claude/rules/plan-hygiene.md)'
